content.text: Which best describes the state of the cake? Choices:  A. About 7/8 of the cake is frosted. The left half of the cake has sprinkles. The missing frosting is on the top right. B. About 1/8 of the cake is frosted. The right half of the cake has sprinkles. The missing frosting is on the top left. C. About 3/4 of the cake is frosted. The bottom of the cake has sprinkles. The missing frosting is on the top. D. About 7/8 of the cake is frosted. The right half of the cake has sprinkles. The missing frosting is on the top left. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
